question: Which of the following states of India receives initial rainfall by the Arabian Sea branch of monsoon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kerala** is the first state in India to receive rainfall from the Arabian Sea branch of the monsoon.
 
• The monsoon typically hits the Kerala coast around the beginning of June, marking the start of the rainy season in India.
